name: Snack Time Combo
subtitle: Sweetened with jaggery | NO Palm Oil

ingredients.name: Ragi
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Ragi also known as Finger Millets, are high in nutrition and help with Calcium, Iron and Fiber.

ingredients.name: Jaggery
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Jaggery (or Gud as called in Hindi) is one of the best natural sweeteners. It helps in regulation of body temperature and detoxifies the body. It also prevents constipation and improves digestion.

ingredients.name: Bajra
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Bajra also known as Pearl Millets, are antioxidents and help in children's growth.

ingredients.name: Hazelnut Paste
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Hazelnut paste is rich in healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals, supporting brain development and immune function in kids while offering a delicious and versatile spread for sandwiches, fruits, and baked goods..

fullIngredientsList: Natural Hazelnut Paste, Cocoa Solids, Groundnut Oil, Jaggery Powder, Milk Solids (Whole Milk Powder), Emulsifier (Sunflower Lecithin), Ragi, Bajra. Strawberry Honey Jam: Strawberry Pulp (50%), FOS (Fructooligosaccharides), Honey, Pectin (Stabilizer), Citric Acid (Acidity Regulator), Natural Colour (Beetroot), Natural Flavour (Strawberry). Grain blend (65%) Ingredients: (Oats flour, Jowar flour, Ragi flour, Kodo millet), Jaggery powder, Raising agent INS 500 (ii), Baking powder, Cocoa powder, Iodized salt and Natural identical flavour Vanilla.

description:
Our healthy snack kit includes chocolate hazelnut spread, strawberry honey jam and chocolate pancake mix for your kids!

🌰 Our rich hazelnut and cocoa spread for kids has ragi and bajra to promote immunity in kids = what more can a healthy spread have!

🍓100% Strawberries, 0% Added Sugar – Enjoy the pure taste of ripe strawberries without any refined sugar.

 💪 Millet-based pancakes with 8g protein in kids' favorite chocolate flavor!

❌No Palm Oil| No Preservatives | No Refined Sugar | No Artificial Flavours

Top pancakes, toast, or crackers with jam and spreads yummy bites for little smiles!

For 2–3 year olds, please check with your nutritionist before serving.
